party_a_statement: Mechanic B charged me 18000 INR for AC repairs I never authorized. I only brought the car for oil change.
party_b_statement: Customer explicitly approved full AC compressor replacement via WhatsApp audio and text when notified of gas leak.

evidence.description: WhatsApp chat history with clear written authorization
evidence.text: WhatsApp Chat on 12 Feb. Mechanic: 'AC compressor is seized, replacement costs 18000 INR. Should we proceed?' Customer A: 'Yes please proceed with compressor replacement so AC works properly.'

evidence.description: Supplier invoice for new compressor part
evidence.text: AutoParts Distributor Invoice #9012 for Denso AC Compressor: 14500 INR.
